name: Lyo.FeatureFlags
tagline: Named flags for apps and workers: on, off, percentage rollout, and caller rules.
description: IFeatureFlagService.IsEnabled reads a snapshot taken at registration. An unknown name is off. AddFeatureFlags, an options instance, or AddFeatureFlagsFromConfiguration all register that service. The first registration wins. Percentage hashes the flag name with a stickiness key into a stable bucket. Rules match user, tenant, claim, and attribute. Apps pass a FeatureFlagContext. HTTP hosts use Lyo.FeatureFlags.AspNetCore.
features: **IFeatureFlagService.** IsEnabled(name, context). Whitespace names throw. Names compare ordinal-ignore-case.
**Modes.** Off, On, Percentage, and Rules. On ignores the caller. Percentage 0 is off and 100 is on. A missing name is off.
**Stickiness.** User, Tenant, or a named attribute. StickinessKey on the context overrides that choice for a partial percentage.
**Rules.** Rules are OR. Predicates inside one rule are AND. A claim or attribute matches when any caller pair equals.
**Fluent Add.** On, Percentage, StickToTenant, StickToAttribute, WhenClaim, and When for an AND rule. The last mode call wins.
**Configuration.** Section FeatureFlags. Each Flags child is bound on its own. A bad Mode throws ConfigurationException. A missing section leaves every flag off.
